scope: ProDy ANM numerical first-mode/subspace reference only; no biological accuracy verdict
selection: ProDy parsePDB chain A, subset calpha, model1; 46 CA atoms in parser order

parameters.zero_mode_exclusion: ProDy default ZERO=1e-6; calcModes default zeros=False

sign_convention: Canonical first mode has largest-absolute component positive; pivot is flattened atom-major xyz index. Alternative global eigenvector sign is equally valid: compare minimum errors of +reference and -reference, with ONE global sign across ALL frames, not a separate sign for each residue/frame.
degenerate_handling: Compare full orthogonal projector, not individual basis signs/rotations, for equal-eigenvalue cluster. A candidate mode in a degenerate cluster may differ from canonical first vector; it must be unit norm, lie in frozen subspace and use the specified phase amplitude consistently. This input first cluster is nondegenerate if dimension=1, so sign-only comparison applies. Do not treat distinct nearby eigenvalues as degenerate beyond frozen threshold.
